primary_headings.usage: Bold, punchy athletic headings for pages, cards, and results.

byline_and_accents.usage: Specifically for the Header Byline and elegant, faith-based accents.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible body text for quiz questions, meaning text, and UI elements.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders (#27272A) and subtle glows for active states.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp corners or minimal 4px radius to maintain a structured, disciplined athletic aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use the dark texture background for headers and subtle noise overlays on dark surfaces.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid colorful gradients. Use dark fade-outs (black to transparent) over imagery.

header.background: Use the dark texture background image. background-size: cover, background-position: center.
header.logo: Embed official book logo, max height 50px, aligned left.
header.byline: Next to logo. Text: 'Discipleship Training, One Rep at a Time'. Font: Cinzel, bold, small-caps, colored white.
header.navigation: Clean text links ONLY. No button background shapes. White text, transitions to gold (#D4AF37) on hover. Hamburger menu on mobile (white).

auth.layout: Centered or split-screen with an inspiring gym background on one side.
auth.elements: Include marketing opt-in checkbox. Primary CTA button in Gold (#D4AF37) with black text.

dashboard.layout: Bento grid or structured list for the 7 assessments. 'Reps' metaphor for progress.
dashboard.cards: Dark surface (#121212) with 1px border. Clear status badges (Not Started, In Progress, Completed).

quiz.likert_scale: 1-5 scale using custom radio buttons. Do NOT use default HTML radios. Create a horizontal flex layout (stack on mobile) of selectable boxes. Explicit labels: 'Rarely True' on the left (1), 'Consistently True under pressure' on the right (5).

results_individual.layout: Large, bold score display (Oswald font). Clear designation category (e.g., Novice, Elite). Meaning text formatted elegantly for readability.

master_results.locked_state: If not all 7 are complete, show a blurred or dimmed overlay with a lock icon and message 'Complete all 7 reps to unlock Master Results'.
master_results.table: 5-column data table: Sections, Chapters, Day 1 Score, Today Score, Change. Rows for 5 book sections. Bottom TOTAL row 'Total out of 125'.
master_results.indicators: Positive changes must use green text (#22C55E) and an upward arrow icon.

layouts.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (py-12 to py-24 for sections). Compact, disciplined spacing within data tables (py-3 px-4).
layouts.grids: Use 12-column grid system for complex layouts. Master results table should be scrollable on mobile.

motion.hover: Navigation links and buttons should have a quick 150ms ease-in-out color transition.
motion.page_load: Fade in core content. Stagger the entrance of the 7 dashboard assessment cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the textured header background meets contrast ratios (use a slight dark overlay if the texture is too bright).
accessibility.focus: Gold outline for focused inputs and buttons.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., 'login-button', 'nav-dashboard', 'quiz-option-1').

header_texture.description: Dark, textured background with subtle white speckles - for header background.

logo_placeholder.description: Gold emblem on dark background to serve as the book logo placeholder.

welcome_gateway_bg.description: Shirtless man lifting barbell in dark gym - inspiring background for welcome page.

quiz_bg_overlay.description: Person about to lift the barbell - background for auth or quiz loading states.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid dark backgrounds with subtle grain/texture.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or structured bento grids for the dashboard.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; for this athletic app, prefer solid dark surfaces (#121212) with sharp 1px borders (#27272A) over heavily blurred glass.
NEVER use the 'transition: all' CSS property. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Use modern, sharp-edged or slightly rounded buttons (e.g., rounded-sm) to fit the athletic discipline theme, colored in Gold (#D4AF37) for primary actions.
Avoid AI assistant emojis. Use lucide-react icons (e.g., Dumbbell, Lock, CheckCircle, ArrowUp).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key informational elements.
libraries_and_tools: recharts (Optional for results charts, though table is explicitly requested)
framer-motion (For staggering dashboard cards and route transitions)
